items.title: RFK Jr backs compounding of six unapproved peptides in new policy
items.summary: The policy will allow licensed professionals to use certain wellness-focused peptides not approved by the FDA in their compounded medicines.

items.title: Gaelic Labs: the EU Critical Medicines Act will have a positive impact on supply
items.summary: Gaelic Labs is eyeing competitive benefits from its 2025 acquisition of fellow Irish beta-lactams manufacturer and further expansion.

items.title: IDWeek 2026: Abrysvo data in nursing home residents could support re-vaccination
items.summary: Abrysvo was first approved in the US in 2023 for the prevention of lower respiratory tract disease (LRTD) caused by RSV.

items.title: UK Budget light on life sciences but more doors open for biotech startups
items.summary: Reaction from the life sciences industry to the Autumn Budget was mixed, with the government opting for a more macro focus on business scaling.

items.title: Podcast: ESMO26: Major readouts from the 2026 congress
items.summary: This week's podcast features the Clinical Trials Arena team and GlobalData analysts who discuss the biggest study readouts from the ESMO Congress 2026.
